title: Action-log binary round-trip verifies only 2 of 7 command tags; Cmd_Place_Router (tag 7) symmetry untested
detail: The binary format's symmetry for 5 tags (Upgrade, Demolish, Lane_Weights, Triage, Place_Router) is never asserted. A future read/write divergence in any of them — incl. tag 7 that real runs now emit — would pass this test silently.
recommended_fix: Either log_write then log_read an action_log containing all 7 command kinds (drive testkit_autowire first), or expand the #partial switch to assert every kind's fields so all tags are covered.
